item.title: Trying to change my home broadband shouldn't be this hard
item.description: I’ve been a Vodafone broadband customer for years. Like a lot of people working from home in tech, i’ve traditionally run a business account on my residential line, mostly because it’s the easiest way to get a static IP and, in theory at least, slightly better support when things go sideways. My current contract term recently expired. Since they already hit me with the usual annual price rise every April anyway, coming out of the minimum term was mostly just my prompt to sit down, look at what renewal options were available, and see if I could get a better deal, or whether it was time to jump ship.
